$schema_note: This is a deliberately simple example policy for the reference RDP demo. Production Aiyo policies compose evidence signals, approval workflows, budget checks, and more — evaluated against merchant-owned policy inside the hosted RDP. See aiyoplane.com for details.

rules.description: Staging deploys are freely allowed in the demo.
Production deploys are denied by this demo policy. In real Aiyo, this is where you would require an approval evidence signal, a change-window check, or an on-call attestation before authorizing.
rules.reason: Production deploys require an approval evidence signal. Configure your merchant policy to require human-approval or change-window evidence before authorizing this action.

rules.description: Payments up to $50.00 (5000 cents) are allowed.
Payments above $50.00 exceed the demo threshold. In real Aiyo, this is where a settlement-verification evidence signal or a step-up approval workflow would be evaluated.
rules.reason: Amount exceeds demo policy threshold of $50.00. In production, this is where an escalation policy or settlement-verification evidence signal would be evaluated.
